integrity: The general proof is analytic. The included code checks finite recurrences, sink components and density profiles. Independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: The expected-time bound is not asserted sharp. The Perrin sequence and its cycle-independent-set interpretation are known, not claimed new. Finite verification covers n=3 through 11 only. Novelty search is bounded.
title: Perrin attractor census and quadratic absorption bound for stochastic minority on wheels
